rationale: Builds directly on state/best_script.py with a surgical minimum-step gate before the expensive quant-aware roundtrip phase. The 1.5111 best starts quant-aware at about step 701, so a 640-step floor keeps the proven normal-throughput path intact while preventing recent slow-start runs from spending the wallclock on quantized rehearsal at step ~51 before the recurrent tail has actually trained. VAL_LOSS_EVERY remains 0 and the exact final int8+zlib evaluation path is preserved.
title: Maturity-Gated Quant-Aware Endgame
